lines: Management, Economics, and Mathematics, School of

Completion of first-year requirements, including Economics 1021A/B and Economics 1022A/B with no mark less than 60%, Mathematics 1230A/B with no mark less than 70% or Calculus 1000A/B with no mark less than 55%, Mathematics 1229A/B with no mark less than 70% or Mathematics 1600A/B with no mark less than 55%, Management and Organizational Studies 1033A/B and Psychology 1000 or 1000W/X with no mark less than 60% each.

Students who fail to meet the 60% in Economics 1021A/B and 1022A/B, or the former Economics 1020 may take a Minor module if they have a mark of at least 60% in each of Economics 2150A/B or Economics 2260A/B and Economics 2152A/B or Economics 2220A/B. Management and Organizational Studies 1033A/B and/or Psychology 1000 may be completed in year 2.
1.0 course from: Analytics and Decision Sciences 2036A/B, Economics 2222A/B, Economics 2223A/B.
1.5 courses: Analytics and Decision Sciences 2288F/G, Analytics and Decision Sciences 2298A/B, Analytics and Decision Sciences 3864A/B.
0.5 course from: Psychology 2135A/B, Psychology 2221A/B, Psychology 2840F/G, Psychology 2990A/B.

1.0 course from: Analytics and Decision Sciences 3293A/B, Analytics and Decision Sciences 4293F/G*, Analytics and Decision Sciences 4294F/G, Economics 3386A/B, and up to 0.5 course from any Analytics and Decision Sciences special topics course numbered 3000-level or above.
*Students who wish to obtain the CORS Diploma must take Analytics and Decision Sciences 4293F/G.
Statistical Sciences 2035 may be substituted for Economics 2222A/B and Analytics and Decision Sciences 2036A/B if completed prior to Fall 2024.
Economics 2122A/B may be substituted for Economics 2222A/B if completed prior to Fall 2024.
Other courses as approved by the Department may be substituted. Please consult the Department for more information.
